meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地 AI 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用本地模型。
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call local models from a container via OpenAI-compatible API.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 多出两个工具:列出本地 Atomic Chat 的模型,以及把问题交给指定模型回答。Claude 仍负责对话,但推理可交给本地模型。
howto.when: 当用户要求用本地 Atomic Chat 模型处理任务(例如提到“Atomic Chat”或说“用本地模型”)时触发。

say.text: 用 Atomic Chat 告诉我法国的首都。
say.note: Claude 会列出模型,再选一个回答。

say.text: 列出 Atomic Chat 当前可用的模型。
用 Atomic Chat 里的 Llama 3.2 3B 把这句译成中文。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude gains two tools: one lists models downloaded in the local Atomic Chat app, and the other sends a prompt to a specified model and returns the answer. Claude stays the orchestrator but can offload reasoning to local models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to use local Atomic Chat models, e.g. mentioning 'Atomic Chat' or saying 'use local model'.

say_en.text: Use Atomic Chat to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Claude lists models, then picks one to answer.

say_en.text: List the models currently available in Atomic Chat.
Use Llama 3.2 3B in Atomic Chat to translate this into Chinese.
